Rules / Formatting

SK0207 The instance-member qualifier is not arranged

skala arrange would add or remove this. for the referenced member kind.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since2.0

Why

Adding or removing this. is safe only when the resulting identifier binds to the same field, property, method or event. The arranger compares symbols and reverts a rewrite that changes binding.

Example

Instead of:

this._value = value;

Write:

_value = value;

When it does not fire

Shadowed names and any rewrite that changes symbol binding are left untouched.

Configuration

  • dotnet_style_qualification_for_field
